label: Nokia G-010S-Q GPON SFP ONT
description: mini-GPON ONT built into an SFP module (CIG G-97S ODM, Realtek RTL9601CI, 16 MB Macronix MX25L12835F flash) that presents itself to the host router as an HSGMII Ethernet interface at 2.5 Gbit/s; GPON line rate 2.488 Gbit/s down / 1.244 Gbit/s up on SC/APC with no LAN ports and no Wi-Fi, managed over its web UI or telnet (web UI only while the PON link is down).
